research_purpose: Determine whether good-view shared-world-state representation learning, without a tokenizer or transformer, improves intervention prediction, unfamiliar-dynamics transfer and cold retention compared with fully trained conventional alternatives; embedding alignment alone never establishes scientific success.

paper.claimed_empirical_42x_scope: training positive-pair SAMPLES to matched representation alignment, not GPU time, FLOPs, behavior or language capability
paper.theorem_scope: Shared finite world, injective renderings, identical positive-pair kernels, population-optimal modality encoders, uniqueness up to orthogonal transform (spectral gap for whitened second-order objective). No guarantee for partial observation or action-conditioned prediction.
paper.integration: Conceptual inspiration only; no downloaded pretrained weights, remote datasets, third-party training runtime or unqualified new dependencies.

hypotheses.H0: A JEPA trained with good independently sampled observations of the same causal initial state improves untrained-procrustes OOD cross-view geometry over a same-trace augmentation control with identical encoder capacity and data budgets.
hypotheses.H1: If H0 succeeds, fitting a separate action-conditioned predictor on the good-view latent improves held-out new-family intervention outcome MSE over the best fully trained recurrent, contrastive, predictive-only, and kernel controls at matched information/actions and measured total compute.
hypotheses.H2: The latent represents causal state rather than superficial positive-pair shortcuts: shuffled-state positives destroy benefit, independent nuisance/graph permutations preserve it, post-switch context ablations damage performance, and source-family competence survives sequential new-family learning.
hypotheses.separation: Embedding geometry, intervention behavior and retention are independent outcomes; H0 success without H1/H2 counts REPRESENTATION_ONLY_NOT_INTELLIGENCE_GAIN.

world_and_views.simulator: Exact pinned G7-S20 two-dimensional hidden (x,z), source/sine/rational family, sensor y=x+0.25*z with independent noise, interventions u and continuous dt. New paired-view adapter may change only observation presentation and initial-state cloning, not scientific dynamics or coefficients; prove wrapper equivalence against original simulator.
world_and_views.pair_semantics: For each synthetic world initial hidden state and physical coefficients, independently draw two DIFFERENT action schedules, independent sensor noise and nuisance. Two views share ONLY initial state/coefficient identity, NOT an identical sensor trajectory. Must not pair post-action states that differ after interventions.

view_sensor_sequence.encoder: GRU/state-space recurrent encoder over real-valued observation transitions

view_event_graph.nodes: 32 numeric event nodes: (sensor_y, continuous_u, dt, measured_next_sensor, measured_delta_y, normalized_observation_time)
view_event_graph.edges: chronological predecessor/successor and optional learned numerical similarity weighted edges; graph permutations are nuisance only
view_event_graph.encoder: two-round shared-parameter message-passing network with permutation-invariant pooling, no discrete vocabulary or event tokens

world_and_views.pairing_metadata: Hidden initial state/coefficient keys used by data generator ONLY for constructing positive pairs and calculating post-hoc analysis; never input to encoders or action heads.
world_and_views.theory_caveat: Single noisy scalar sensor is not injective. Temporal interventions may make dynamics locally observable but this must be tested empirically; the published PRH theorem does not automatically apply.
world_and_views.positive_control: Exact physical consequence oracle MSE zero by construction; known competent recurrent/kernel predictor must demonstrate sensor-action learnability before cross-model scientific interpretation.

treatment_arms.good_view: Two SEPARATELY TRAINED modality-specific JEPA encoders on independent same-initial-state views; centered whitened second-order anti-collapse loss and no cross-modal gradient or correspondence labels in encoder training; fit one O(k) Procrustes matrix using train-only paired states for downstream geometry scoring.
treatment_arms.same_trace_bad_view: Matched dual encoders, same number of pairs, but positives are augmentations of one sampled trajectory retaining modality nuisance; independent positive-pair world relationship absent.
treatment_arms.shuffled_positive_negative: Matched dual encoders; random other-world positive with same family and nuisance marginals, exact corruption rate 100%; strong negative.
treatment_arms.contrastive: Matched architecture, good-view relationship, InfoNCE contrastive objective with same action/info budget and no label shortcuts.
treatment_arms.predictive_only: Matched recurrent and graph encoder budgets, supervised action-conditioned next-observation training without JEPA representation objective.
treatment_arms.GRU_conventional: Fully trained conventional recurrent action-conditioned world model, matched data/actions and total active compute where possible; strongest control, not merely 8 optimizer updates.
treatment_arms.RBF_KRR: Calibrated non-neural kernel ridge predictor, fixed train-only hyperparameter grid, as additional competent conventional control.
treatment_arms.random_init: Same untrained encoder and trained readout to test whether gains are actually due to learned views.
treatment_arms.oracle: Synthetic hidden-state physical engine, evaluation only; no learning and not a fair trained-model baseline.

train.stop_gradient_policy: separate encoders independently; within-modality paired loss compares both trainable embeddings with identical optimizer configuration
train.budget_rule: Each arm receives exactly the same distinct WORLD IDs, initial states, action-probe counts and intervention labels; compare measured examples, active FLOPs, CPU wall, RSS and optimizer updates. Raw pair count is not equal to compute.
train.conventional_baseline_training: Use precommitted 5-check validation plateau rule on validation-only worlds after at least 640 updates: <0.1% improvement across five spaced evaluations, maximum 1600 per phase; other arms may train to the same measured compute envelope. If conventional baseline is undertrained, science qualification invalid.
train.fresh_vs_pretrained: All networks initialize from seeded random weights. No pretrained transformer, LLM, human-generated captions, web-crawled datasets, external model or paid API.

test.sample_provenance: Disjoint train/validation/test initial states and dynamics coefficients; heldout dynamics coefficient ranges disjoint from fit/calibration with exact seed/parameter manifest. Repeated-world leakage must be automatically rejected.
metrics: test Procrustes alignment error after rotation fitted on training-world pairs only
whitened encoder rank and variance/covariance collapse diagnostics
action-conditioned counterfactual sensor MSE on 8 heldout interventions per world
source/sine/rational OOD zero-shot transfer and C/A,D/A cold retention ratios
post-switch observation occlusion vs true-history causal negative controls
compute-active FLOPs, total CPU seconds, peak RSS, train-world count, training samples and checkpoint bytes

paired_bootstrap.condition: train-only parameters frozen prior to eval, paired on same heldout initial states and interventions

test.false_claim_gate: No theorem validation or intelligence-level conclusions from these synthetic/partial-observation outcomes.

qualifications.phase_0: READ_ONLY source/manifest check and independent-view pairing, deterministic seed, exact state provenance, no ID-feature leakage and graph permutation negative controls; no scientific inference.
qualifications.phase_1: ENGINEERING qualification on an exact candidate SHA and existing qualified platform; full platform regression and immutable receipts when code changes are promoted.
qualifications.phase_2: One separately authorized frozen first-use run on fresh seeds (not covered by this registration), with strong conventional controls and complete resource costs.
qualifications.phase_3: Independent source/custody reproduction and separate scientifically accepted result; never inferred from green CI.
invalid_outcomes: cross-modal training when independently trained claimed
unmatched information or compute presented as controlled
